common.offlineDescription: Your walk is being saved on this device and will sync when you're back online.

onboarding.step1Body: Start a walk and take any route you like — as long as you come back around.
onboarding.step2Body: When your path crosses itself or returns near the start, the ground inside becomes yours.
onboarding.step3Body: Other players can walk into your land and take it. New territory is protected for {{hours}} hours.

auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.

username.title: Pick your name
username.subtitle: This is how other players see you on the map. You can't change it later.
username.rules: 3–20 characters. Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
username.invalid: Use 3–20 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.

permissions.locationTitle: TerraWars needs your location while you walk
permissions.locationBody: We record your route only while a walk is running, so we can work out the area you enclosed. We never track you in the background, and other players never see your route or your live position — only the finished territory.
permissions.locationBullet1: Only while a walk is running
permissions.locationDenied: Without location access we can't record a walk.
permissions.notificationsBody: We'll let you know when another player takes some of your land, so you can go and take it back.

safety.title: Walk safely
safety.body: Watch the road, not your phone. Don't walk into traffic, private property, or anywhere unsafe to claim territory.

battery.title: Keep your walk running
battery.body: Your phone may stop the walk in the background to save battery. Allowing unrestricted background activity for TerraWars keeps your route recording all the way round.

map.title: World
map.emptyBody: Be the first to walk a loop around this area.
map.loadFailed: Couldn't load the map. Check your connection.
map.locationOff: Location is off — tap to turn it on

walk.discardConfirmBody: Your route and distance won't be saved.
walk.keepWalkingHint: Keep going — your loop isn't closed yet.
walk.resumeBody: You have a walk from {{time}} that wasn't finished.
walk.autoEndedDistance: Walk ended — you passed the {{distance}} limit.
walk.autoEndedDuration: Walk ended — you passed the {{duration}} limit.
walk.queuedOffline: Saved. We'll claim this as soon as you're online.
walk.waitingForGpsHint: Step outside if you can — this usually takes a few seconds.

claimResult.blockedBody: {{username}}'s parcel was claimed recently and is protected until {{time}}. You kept everything outside it.

errors.ERR_LOOP_NOT_CLOSED: Your walk didn't make a loop. Walk back near where you started to claim the area.
errors.ERR_AREA_TOO_SMALL: That loop is too small to claim. Try one at least the size of a city block.
errors.ERR_AREA_TOO_LARGE: That loop is too big to claim in one go. Try splitting it into smaller loops.
errors.ERR_DISTANCE_TOO_SHORT: You need to walk at least {{distance}} to claim land.
errors.ERR_DURATION_TOO_SHORT: That was a bit quick. Walks need to last at least {{duration}}.
errors.ERR_TOO_FAST: This looks like a ride, not a walk. Claims are for walking and running only.
errors.ERR_IMPOSSIBLE_AREA: We couldn't verify this route. Your walk was still saved.
errors.ERR_TELEPORT: Your location jumped during this walk. Your walk was still saved.
errors.ERR_TOO_FEW_POINTS: We didn't get enough location readings on this walk.
errors.ERR_INTEGRITY: We couldn't verify your location data on this device.
errors.ERR_VALIDATION: Something in that request didn't look right.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account can't play right now. Contact support if you think that's wrong.
errors.ACTIVE_WALK_EXISTS: You already have a walk in progress.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That name is taken. Try another.
errors.WALK_ALREADY_FINISHED: That walk has already been finished.
errors.COLOR_CHANGE_COOLDOWN: You can change your colour once every 30 days.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You've claimed a lot today. Try again later.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: That took too long. Try again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don't match an account.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED: Check your inbox and confirm your email address first.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account already uses that email. Try signing in instead.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: Pick a stronger password — at least 8 characters.
errors.SIGNUP_DISABLED: New accounts aren't being accepted right now.
errors.EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED: Too many confirmation emails have gone out. Wait an hour and try again.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.unranked: Claim some land to get on the board
leaderboard.emptyBody: Walk a loop and you'll be first.
leaderboard.setCityPrompt: Set your city to see a local board

profile.title: Profile
profile.noRaidsBody: Walk over someone else's land to take it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hideWalkStart: Hide the start of my walks
settings.hideWalkStartHint: Trims the first and last {{distance}} of your route so a walk from home doesn't put your front door on the map.
settings.colorCooldown: You can change this again on {{date}}
settings.deleteAccountBody: Your profile, walks and location history are removed. Your territory stays on the map but no longer belongs to anyone. This can't be undone.
